comparison.objective: Swipe a magnetic-stripe card through a reader once and return it to a stand; unlike screening a mixed batch.
comparison.physical_skill: Orienting a thin card and maintaining constrained one-direction speed through a narrow slot versus bimanual load sharing and agitation-driven granular flow.
comparison.success_condition: Requires a good one-pass read within speed, direction, stripe-orientation, and slot-height limits, followed by stand replacement; no mass recovery or retained-workpiece condition. No material rubric detail is missing.
comparison.reason: The common idea of passing an object through an opening is generic; controlled swipe trajectory is not selective screening.
